intent.summary: Make History exports deterministic and complete: no implicit 20-row truncation; define stable ordering rules for merged exports.
intent.whyNow: Users exporting multi-page results observed missing rows and confusing order; export correctness must match stored data and user expectations.

decisions.title: Default row limit semantics
options: Default to 20 rows unless maxRows is provided
Default to unlimited unless maxRows is provided
decisions.decision: Default to unlimited; preview must pass an explicit limit.
decisions.rationale: Exports/copy/download should never silently truncate. Preview remains fast by passing a concrete limit.

decisions.title: Bulk export ordering
options: Use current UI ordering (often extracted_at DESC)
Use added order (extractions.id ASC) and optionally seq/index asc
decisions.decision: Use added order baseline; implement conservative seq/index asc for merged formats when detectable.
decisions.rationale: Added order is stable and matches user intent. Seq/index sorting matches common multi-page result expectations.

commandsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "bulk export merged CSV"
testsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "bulk export merged CSV"

evidence.notes: M1 (remove implicit 20-row truncation) and M2 (stable ordering + seq/index sort for merged export) implemented; validated via typecheck/unit/build.

followUps: Optional: add a Playwright E2E assertion that validates CSV/TSV ordering on a known fixture.
